name: Ancient Forest Dragon — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Ancient Forest Dragon from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Forest Dragon, Ancient" but are not part of the Ancient Forest Dragon entry, which is unchanged.

Woodland Stride (Ex)

As the druid ability of the same name.

Editor’s Notes

We noted the following errors:

Frightful Presence DC should be 27 (10 base +12 HD +5 Cha).
Breath Weapon, Crush, and Tail Sweep should all be DC 30 (10 base+ 12 HD+ 8 CON).
Skills are bit off:
Acrobatics +24 (25 ranks -1 Dex)
Bluff +37 ( 25 ranks +3 class +5 Cha +4 feat)
Climb +49 (25 ranks +3 class +13 Str +8 Climb speed)
Fly -15 (-1 Dex – 8 clumsy -6 size)
Knowledge (25 ranks +3 class +5 Int)
Survival +33 (25 ranks +3 class +5 Wis)
GM’s are encouraged to use these statistics.
